summary: Sona, founded in 2021 by Steffen Wulff Petersen, Oli Johnson, and Ben Dixon and headquartered in London, is an AI-powered frontline workforce-management platform (forecasting, scheduling, HR, payroll, and an AI assistant called 'Raffy') for hospitality and healthcare employers, with named customers including Popeyes UK. (Scope note: Popeyes UK is a single named customer/market reference; not evidence of broader Popeyes global deployment.)

Sona closed a $45 million Series B in April 2026, led by N47 with participation from existing investors Felicis, Northzone, Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and Italian Founders Fund, bringing total funding to over $100 million; this follows a prior £21.85 million Series A led by Felicis in 2024.
